svg.title: MCPVault
svg.desc: Pixel-art banner: Claude calls a vault of linked Markdown notes through a gate of five tool lamps. An orient call lights the first lamp; a search lights another, a scan line sweeps the notes and one note and its links light up; a copy of the note flies back to Claude; a third call revises the note, its lines are rewritten and its revision goes from REV 3 to REV 4; a commit lands on the GIT line and a new link joins two notes.
